sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','c','N'):
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rs),min(cs)))
    # W/g 9px blocks
    wg=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('W','g') and n['pixels']==9:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            wg.append((n['color'],min(rs),min(cs)))
    return d,sorted(wg)
b1,w1 = snap(current_frame)
print('BEFORE player', b1.get('b'), b1.get('c'))
print('BEFORE W near row15:', [x for x in w1 if x[1]==15])
res = action(['RIGHT'], intent='explore')
b2,w2 = snap(current_frame)
print('AFTER  player', b2.get('b'), b2.get('c'))
print('AFTER  W near row15:', [x for x in w2 if x[1]==15])
print('result', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','c','N'):
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rs),min(cs)))
    # W/g 9px blocks
    wg=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('W','g') and n['pixels']==9:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            wg.append((n['color'],min(rs),min(cs)))
    return d,sorted(wg)
b1,w1 = snap(current_frame)
print('BEFORE player', b1.get('b'), b1.get('c'))
print('BEFORE W near row15:', [x for x in w1 if x[1]==15])
res = action(['RIGHT'], intent='explore')
b2,w2 = snap(current_frame)
print('AFTER  player', b2.get('b'), b2.get('c'))
print('AFTER  W near row15:', [x for x in w2 if x[1]==15])
print('result', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact')})
